description:
Angry IP scanner is a very fast IP address and port scanner.


- Minimum required Java is now 21, due to updated SWT
- Bundle Java 25 with Windows and Mac builds
- Virtual Threads are now used by default without the maximum upper limit
- Default display mode is now Alive Only, so dead hosts are not shown
- MacOS build should not require Rosetta anymore
- Added Japanese translations
- Update all translations with newer keys
- Fixed some rare crashes if no network connectivity
- Fixed possible SQL injection when executing files generated by SQLExporter
- Make getting started dialog resizable
- Security: plugin trust confirmation dialog - new plugins require user approval before loading
- Security: shell arguments are now quoted when passed to openers to prevent command injection via DNS poisoning
- Better escaping in XMLExporter & CSVExporter
- Many minor stability fixes
- Updated MAC vendors
